# AI Payment Control Plane

> Pre-sign authorization infrastructure for AI-agent payments. The service evaluates a proposed payment before an external wallet or processor signs it.

## What it does

- Accepts a structured payment intent through `POST /check`.
- Returns `ALLOW`, `BLOCK`, or `REQUIRE_APPROVAL` with stable reason codes and an audit receipt.
- Applies owner policy, budgets, duplicate checks, payee controls, velocity checks, price anomaly signals, and prompt-to-payment risk signals.
- Supports HTTPS and an MCP tool interface.

- Pilot request: https://github.com/mercadosclaro-eng/ai-payment-control-plane/issues/new?template=pilot-request.yml

## Boundaries

- The service does not hold funds or private keys.
- The service does not sign, transmit, or settle payments.
- A wallet, processor, or other external signer remains responsible for execution.
- The public product name PayGuard is a working name.
- No guaranteed fraud prevention or regulatory certification is claimed.

## Integration rule

Call `/check` immediately before signing. Continue only when the returned decision is `ALLOW`; stop or request owner approval for every other result. Verify the current request and receipt again at the signer boundary.
